messages:
Maria (AE): Customer asked for BCP/DR specifics in SIG: explicit RTO/RPO, backup cadence & retention, restore test evidence, failover mechanics, and SLA wording. Can we draft concise answers + tiny runbook excerpt?

Jordan (Security): Will do. We should separate Hosted vs Dedicated/Private in responses.

Sam (Eng): Key facts: control plane replicated across AZs, primary DB WAL-shipped to standby in a secondary region, object storage snapshots hourly, nightly full backups. Caches are ephemeral.

Jordan (Security): Draft SIG language — Hosted: Multi-AZ replication with automated snapshots. Control-plane RTO objective <= 1 hour; persisted customer data RPO ~15 minutes (WAL + hourly snapshots). Dedicated/Private: RTO/RPO configurable per SOW and can be tightened.

Jordan (Security): Failover: automated health checks + routing switch to healthy cluster; for region loss we trigger cross-region DNS failover and promote standby. Routing switch ~1–5 minutes; full restore time varies by dataset size.

Sam (Eng): Backup & retention: hourly incremental snapshots, nightly full backups retained 30 days by default. Longer retention/export available as add-on. Restore tests: quarterly restore drills; we can provide sanitized test logs/screenshots as evidence.

Olivia (Legal): Suggested SLA phrasing: "Hosted: 99.9% monthly uptime SLA; Dedicated: 99.95% (per contract). Remedies subject to SLA terms and exclusions (customer misconfiguration, third-party network, force majeure)." Keep wording reference-only in SIG.

DR Playbook Bot: https://runbooks.redwood.internal/dr-tests/latest — last full restore drill: 2025-02-14 (index #34).

Maria (AE): Perfect. I'll paste these into the SIG spreadsheet and request the sanitized drill artifacts from ops.

Jordan (Security): I'll pull the sanitized logs and upload within 24h.

Olivia (Legal): LGTM. Avoid hard promises outside contract. :white_check_mark:

Maria (AE): Thanks everyone, sending to customer now.
